checks.name: only completed purchases create incoming stock
transfer creates equal opposing store legs
adjustment is shrinkage with a single outgoing leg
captured dates/stores and missing units stay unknown
historical closing balances never inferred from current stock
namespace IDs are unique across record domains and transfer legs
IDs survive record sorting and unrelated line insertion
duplicate item lines and captured IDs remain independently addressable
transaction snapshots retain name and unit after catalog changes
mixed product/material transactions follow each line kind
nonfinite/zero/negative transaction quantities excluded; signed captured quantities retained
invalid calendar date remains undated instead of rolling over
missing transfer destination never invents a receipt
dated records newest first, undated last, deterministic ties
search trims case and matches SKU/reference/store/name/operation
store/type/date filters combine and exclude unknown metadata
reset filter restores full selected-kind history
small fractional amounts stay nonzero and retain the source unit
projection and filtering leave source records untouched
empty source and missing IDs produce no invented events
